destinations.name: Chennai
destinations.description: Tamil Nadu's bustling capital city featuring the iconic Marina Beach, Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Fort St. George, and vibrant cultural landmarks.

destinations.name: Mahabalipuram
destinations.description: UNESCO World Heritage coastal haven famous for 7th-century Shore Temples, Pancha Rathas, Arjuna's Penance, and oceanfront breeze along the ECR.

destinations.name: Kanchipuram
destinations.description: The City of Thousand Temples and world-renowned Kanchipuram silk sarees. Home to Ekambareswarar, Varadharaja Perumal, and Kailasanathar temples.

destinations.name: Vellore
destinations.description: Historic gateway home to the gleaming Sripuram Golden Temple covered in gold foil, the 16th-century Vellore Fort, and Jalakandeswarar Temple.

destinations.name: Tiruvannamalai
destinations.description: Sacred spiritual sanctuary of the Agni Lingam at Arunachaleswarar Temple, Ramana Maharshi Ashram, and the holy 14 km Girivalam circumambulation path.

destinations.name: Salem
destinations.description: The Mango City and key commercial center nestled at the foot of the Shevaroy Hills. Gateway to Yercaud, steel plants, and renowned textile markets.

destinations.name: Coimbatore
destinations.description: The Manchester of South India and gateway to the Western Ghats. Famous for Isha Yoga Center's 112ft Adiyogi Shiva bust and Marudhamalai Temple.

destinations.name: Yercaud
destinations.description: The Jewel of the South in the Shevaroy range. A serene, budget-friendly hill station known for tranquil Emerald Lake, coffee estates, and viewpoint cliffs.

destinations.name: Ooty
destinations.description: The Queen of Hill Stations in the Nilgiris. Renowned for lush rolling tea gardens, Government Botanical Garden, Ooty Lake, and Doddabetta Peak.

destinations.name: Kodaikanal
destinations.description: The Princess of Hill Stations in the Palani Hills. Famous for its star-shaped Kodai Lake, misty Coaker's Walk, Pillar Rocks, and pine forests.

destinations.name: Thanjavur
destinations.description: The cultural epicenter of the Chola Empire. Marvel at the 1,000-year-old Brihadisvara Great Living Chola Temple (Big Temple) and Maratha Palace.

destinations.name: Tiruchirappalli
destinations.description: Historic city along the Cauvery River, celebrated for the towering Rockfort Ucchi Pillayar Temple and Srirangam Ranganathaswamy Temple complex.

destinations.name: Kumbakonam
destinations.description: The Temple City renowned for the grand Mahamaham tank and gateway to the 9 sacred Navagraha temples and Airavatesvara Temple in Darasuram.

destinations.name: Chidambaram
destinations.description: Home of Lord Nataraja performing the cosmic Ananda Tandava dance in the iconic Chidambaram Thillai Nataraja Temple with its golden roofed shrine.

destinations.name: Madurai
destinations.description: The Athens of the East and Jasmine City, centered around the breathtaking towers of the ancient Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple and Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace.

destinations.name: Rameswaram
destinations.description: Spiritual island town connected via the legendary Pamban Bridge. Home to Ramanathaswamy Temple's longest pillared corridors, 22 theerthams, and Dhanushkodi.

destinations.name: Tirunelveli
destinations.description: Historic city situated on the banks of the Thamirabarani River. World-famous for the monumental Nellaiappar Temple, Tirunelveli Halwa, and Courtallam Falls nearby.

destinations.name: Kanyakumari
destinations.description: The southernmost tip of mainland India where the Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, and Bay of Bengal converge. Witness simultaneous sunrise and sunset, and Vivekananda Rock Memorial.

packages.title: Chennai City Sightseeing Tour
suggested_itinerary: 08:30 AM - Pickup from door/hotel in Chennai in comfortable AC tourist van.
09:30 AM - Darshan at historic Mylapore Kapaleeshwarar Temple & tank walk.
11:00 AM - Visit Santhome Cathedral Basilica & light house view.
01:00 PM - Lunch at authentic traditional South Indian restaurant.
02:30 PM - Tour Government Museum Egmore & National Art Gallery.
05:00 PM - Relaxing sunset stroll along Marina Beach & food stalls.
07:30 PM - Return drop at your doorstep in Chennai.

packages.title: Mahabalipuram & ECR One-Day Tour
suggested_itinerary: 07:30 AM - Departure from Chennai along the scenic East Coast Road (ECR).
08:30 AM - Optional stop at DakshinaChitra Heritage Museum / Kovalam beach.
10:00 AM - Explore UNESCO World Heritage Shore Temple complex & ocean views.
11:30 AM - Marvel at Five Rathas (Pancha Pandava Rathas) carved monoliths.
01:00 PM - Fresh seafood & vegetarian lunch at beachside cafe.
02:30 PM - Visit Arjuna's Penance, Krishna's Butterball & lighthouse.
04:30 PM - Souvenir stone carving market & beach relaxation.
06:30 PM - Return drive to Chennai with doorstep drop.

packages.title: Ooty & Coonoor Nilgiri Hill Station Holiday
suggested_itinerary: Day 1: Pickup from Chennai / Coimbatore / Bangalore, scenic ghat road drive, hotel check-in in Ooty, evening at Ooty Lake & Mall Road.
Day 2: Full day sightseeing at Government Botanical Garden, Rose Garden, Doddabetta Peak, and visit to Nilgiri Tea Factory with fresh chocolate tasting.
Day 3: Scenic excursion to Coonoor - Sim's Park, Lamb's Rock, Dolphin's Nose viewpoint, followed by return journey.

packages.title: Kodaikanal Family Holiday Tour
suggested_itinerary: Day 1: Departure from Madurai / Trichy / Chennai, scenic drive up Palani Hills, Silver Cascade stop, hotel check-in, evening cycling & boating at Kodai Lake.
Day 2: Morning misty stroll at Coaker's Walk, Bryant Park, Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves, and scenic Pine Forest photography.
Day 3: Visit Kurinji Andavar Temple, solar observatory viewpoint, souvenir homemade chocolate shopping, followed by pleasant return trip.

packages.title: Madurai & Rameswaram Spiritual Circuit
suggested_itinerary: Day 1: Morning arrival in Madurai, special darshan at Meenakshi Amman Temple, afternoon visit to Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal, evening drive to Rameswaram.
Day 2: Early morning sacred 22 Theertham holy dip and darshan at Ramanathaswamy Temple, Pamban bridge crossing, afternoon excursion to Dhanushkodi beach & Rama Sethu point.
Day 3: Visit Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Memorial, return journey with optional stop at Tirupparankunram Murugan Temple.

packages.title: Thanjavur, Kumbakonam & Trichy Chola Heritage Tour
suggested_itinerary: Day 1: Early departure, reach Thanjavur, marvel at UNESCO Brihadisvara (Big Temple), explore Maratha Royal Palace and Art Gallery, evening Aarti at Kumbakonam.
Day 2: Morning visit to Srirangam Ranganathaswamy Temple (largest functioning Hindu temple complex in the world), climb Trichy Rockfort Ucchi Pillayar Temple, return drop.

packages.title: Kanyakumari, Suchindram & Padmanabhapuram Sightseeing
suggested_itinerary: Day 1: Journey to Kanyakumari, check-in, ferry ride to Vivekananda Rock Memorial and 133-ft Thiruvalluvar Statue, sunset view at Triveni Sangam.

Day 2: Early 05:45 AM sunrise watch over the ocean, darshan at Bhagavathy Amman Temple, excursion to Suchindram Temple (Trimurti shrine), and the majestic wooden Padmanabhapuram Palace, evening return.

packages.title: Grand Tamil Nadu Customized Multi-Day Tour
suggested_itinerary: Completely flexible itinerary tailored to your group's preferences. Choose your pickup district, custom route through heritage temples, hill resorts, coastal highways, and wildlife reserves across all 38 districts of Tamil Nadu. Dedicated van and experienced chauffeur for the entire journey.
